L31·N9287unmasked layer
Fires on the *first* sub-token piece of a word/name/number that continues into the next token without a space — e.g. the "T" of "TBC", the "O" of "O'Brien", "Space" in "SpaceBattles", "Body" in "Bodylotion", a digit inside a longer numeral — i.e. a mid-word/compound continuation boundary (strongly suppressed on the *ending* fragments like "amin" of "vitamin" or "ich" of a surname).

L31·N12046unmasked layer
Fires on the token immediately *preceding* a capitalized word beginning with "B" (Benevolent, B in "R&B", Bronze, Ballet, Binse) — i.e., it's a next-token prediction signal for an upcoming capital-B word, regardless of whether that preceding token is punctuation, an abbreviation, "&", or a word.
